name: Strange Alliance
summary: Captain Pentigast seeks an alliance with the Gelkis in Desolace. They are at war with the Magram, and he sends you southwest to Uthek the Wise.

sections.title: Divided Clans
sections.body: Captain Pentigast sees a chance in the centaur clans’ quarrels. Joined together, they could not be stopped. He hopes their division will serve the Alliance. The Gelkis and Magram are locked in a brutal war, so striking at the Magram might persuade the Gelkis to join the Alliance.

sections.title: Seeking Uthek
sections.body: Uthek the Wise is where the Gelkis camps begin in southwestern Desolace. Pentigast hopes she can help secure an alliance. At first, she sends you away. She tells you to return after killing many Magram.

sections.title: Uthek's Answer
sections.body: Uthek the Wise tells you the Gelkis now whisper your name after you have killed many Magram. She approves, and is willing to discuss what you can offer the clan and what it can offer you.

faq.q: Who sends you to contact the Gelkis?
faq.answer: Captain Pentigast sends you to contact the Gelkis, hoping to make an alliance with the clan.

faq.q: Where is Uthek the Wise located?
faq.answer: In southwestern Desolace, at the edge where the Gelkis camps begin.

faq.q: Why will Uthek the Wise not talk to newcomers right away?
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise tells you to leave and return after killing many Magram.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want a pact with the Gelkis?
faq.answer: Captain Pentigast sees the centaur clans’ quarrels as a chance, since they could not be stopped if united. The Gelkis are at war with the Magram, and striking at the Magram might win the Gelkis’ friendship.
